description: 130,946 groundwater wells registered in the provincial GWELLS registry, with construction, depth, yield and aquifer. Published by Watershed Stewardship and Security (Province of British Columbia) as [Groundwater Wells](https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/dataset/groundwater-wells) in the BC Data Catalogue; this is a full province-wide mirror. Query recipes and field notes are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

table:columns.name: GW_WW_SYSID
table:columns.description: A system generated unique identification number

table:columns.name: WELL_TAG_NUMBER
table:columns.description: The file number assigned to a particular well in the in the provincial Groundwater Wells and Aquifers application, e.g., 56809.

table:columns.name: IDENTIFICATION_PLATE_NUMBER
table:columns.description: Steel plate with a unique number that is attached to required wells under the groundwater protection regulations such as water supply wells, recharge or injection wells made by drilling or boring, and permanent dewatering wells, e.g., 691.

table:columns.name: STREET_ADDRESS
table:columns.description: Street address of the property that the well is physically located on.

table:columns.name: CITY
table:columns.description: The city, town, or general locality where the well is located, e.g. Oliver, Gabriola Island.

table:columns.name: LEGAL_LOT
table:columns.description: The smallest designation of land (the lot number) from the legal description of the land parcel where the well is located, e.g., B, 2.

table:columns.name: LEGAL_PLAN
table:columns.description: The plan number from the legal description of the land parcel where the well is located, e.g., 1261, 13604, LMP7728.

table:columns.name: LEGAL_DISTRICT_LOT
table:columns.description: The district lot number from the legal description of the land parcel where the well is located, e.g., 456, 1234s.

table:columns.name: LEGAL_PID
table:columns.description: The parcel identifier (PID) of the land parcel where the well is located, e.g., 014905736.

table:columns.name: WELL_LOCATION_DESCRIPTION
table:columns.description: An informal description of where the well is located on a property, e.g., 50m to the right of the house and behind the shed.

table:columns.name: COORDINATE_ACQUISITION_CODE
table:columns.description: The approximate accuracy of the geographic coordinates provided, e.g., H (default accuracy; (10 m accuracy) handheld GPS with accuracy of +/- 10 meters), A (10 m accuracy - cadastre and good location sketch), C (50 m accuracy - Digitized from 1:20,000 mapping), I (20 m accuracy - no cadastre but good location sketch or good written description), G (unknown, accuracy based on parcel size - No cadastre, poor or no location sketch; site located in center of primary parcel), J (unknown, accuracy based on parcel size - cadastre, poor or no location sketch, arbitrarily located in center of parcel).

table:columns.name: WELL_STATUS
table:columns.description: Description of the status of a well as defined in the Groundwater Protection Regulation of the Water Act, i.e. New, Abandoned, Alteration, Closure, Other.

table:columns.name: WELL_CLASS
table:columns.description: Valid classification as defined in the Groundwater Protection Regulation of the Water Sustainability Act, i.e., Water Supply, Monitoring, Recharge, Injection, Dewatering, Drainage, Remediation, Geotechnical, Closed-loop geoexchange.

table:columns.name: WELL_SUBCLASS
table:columns.description: Valid subclassification as defined in the Groundwater Protection Regulation of the Water Sustainability Act, e.g., Temporary, Permanent, Borehole, Artesian.

table:columns.name: INTENDED_WATER_USE
table:columns.description: The intended use of the water in a water supply well as reported by the driller at time of work completion on the well, e.g., private domestic, irrigation, water supply system, industrial commercial, unknown.

table:columns.name: WELL_DETAILS_URL
table:columns.description: Link to the well summary report within the Groundwater Wells and Aquifer (GWELLS) application, which provides the overall description and history of the well.

table:columns.name: LICENCE_STATUS
table:columns.description: Description of valid licencing option granted to a well under the Water Water Sustainability Act. This information comes from eLicensing, i.e. Unlicensed, Licensed, Historical

table:columns.name: AQUIFER_ID
table:columns.description: System generated unique sequential number assigned to each mapped aquifer. The aquifer ID identifies which aquifer a well is in. An aquifer can have multiple wells, while a single well can only be in one aquifer.

table:columns.name: PERSON_RESPONSIBLE
table:columns.description: Name (and registration ID) of the registered driller or pump installer responsible for constructing, altering, or decommissioning the well, e.g., Jane Doe (WD 06666666).

table:columns.name: COMPANY_OF_PERSON_RESPONSIBLE
table:columns.description: Name (and location) of the registered driller or pump installer company responsible for constructing, altering, or decommissioning the well, e.g., Geotech Drilling Services Ltd. (Vernon, BC).

table:columns.name: FINISHED_WELL_DEPTH
table:columns.description: The depth at which the well was finished, measured in units of feet bgl (below ground level), e.g. 157.0. It can be shallower than the total well depth which is the total depth at which the well was drilled.

table:columns.name: TOTAL_DEPTH_DRILLED
table:columns.description: The deepest depth a well was drilled to, reported as feet below ground level, e.g., 150.

table:columns.name: BEDROCK_DEPTH
table:columns.description: Depth below ground level at which bedrock starts, measured in feet, e.g. 132.0.

table:columns.name: YIELD
table:columns.description: An approximate estimate of the capacity of the well to produce groundwater. Estimated by the well driller during construction by conducting a well yield test. Measured in US Gallons/minute.

table:columns.name: YIELD_ESTIMATION_DURATION
table:columns.description: Length of time (in hours) over which a yield test was conducted by the driller during construction to determine well yield, e.g., 3.25.

table:columns.name: ARTESIAN_COND
table:columns.description: Indicates whether artesian conditions are present for a given well, i.e., Y, N.

table:columns.name: ARTESIAN_FLOW
table:columns.description: Measurement of the artesian well water flow that occurs naturally due to inherent water pressure in the well. Pressure within the aquifer forces the groundwater to rise above the land surface naturally without using a pump. Flowing artesian wells can flow on an intermittent or continuous basis. Measured in US Gallons per minute.

table:columns.name: ARTESIAN_PRESSURE
table:columns.description: Pressure of the water coming out of an artesian well as measured at the time of well construction, measured in PSI (pounds per square inch).

table:columns.name: STATIC_WATER_LEVEL
table:columns.description: The level (depth below top of casing) to which water will naturally rise in a well without pumping, measured in feet, e.g. 280.0

table:columns.name: DIAMETER
table:columns.description: The diameter of the casing of the well, measured in inches, e.g. 6.62. There can be multiple casings in a well, e.g. surface casing, and production casing. Diameter of casing made available to the public is generally the production casing.

table:columns.name: FINAL_CASING_STICK_UP
table:columns.description: Tthe length of the production casing in the well that is above either (a) the surface of the ground adjacent to the well, or (b) the floor of the well sump, pump house or well pit. Measured as inches, e.g., 30.

table:columns.name: GROUND_ELEVATION
table:columns.description: The elevation of the well at ground level. Measured as feet above sea level, e.g., 1050

table:columns.name: GROUND_ELEVATION_METHOD
table:columns.description: Description of how ground elevation of the well was measured, e.g., unknown, GPS, level, 20K_map, 5K_map, DIFF_GPS, altimeter, 10K_map, 50K_map.

table:columns.name: SURFACE_SEAL_DEPTH
table:columns.description: The total depth (length) of the protective surface seal installed around the outside of the outermost casing or between multiple casings, measured in feet, e.g. 16.

table:columns.name: SURFACE_SEAL_THICKNESS
table:columns.description: The distance between the outside of the outermost casing and natural ground, or the distance between multiple casings in which the sealant is installed. Measured in inches, e.g., 2.

table:columns.name: SURFACE_SEAL_METHOD
table:columns.description: Method of how the surface seal was installed around the well casing, i.e., pumped, poured, other.

table:columns.name: SCREEN_INTAKE_METHOD
table:columns.description: Main entry for water into the well, i.e., open bottom, uncased hole, and screen.

table:columns.name: WATER_SUPPLY_SYSTEM_NAME
table:columns.description: Owner of the water supply system using the well, e.g., Township of Langley, Cedar Lake Water System, Copperside Estates.

table:columns.name: WATER_SUPPLY_SYSTEM_WELL_NAME
table:columns.description: Well name or identifier used by the water supply system, e.g., Well#5, north well, pine street well.

table:columns.name: CONSTRUCTION_START_DATE
table:columns.description: The date that the well construction was started.

table:columns.name: CONSTRUCTION_END_DATE
table:columns.description: The date that the well construction was completed.

table:columns.name: ALTERATION_START_DATE
table:columns.description: The date that alteration works, such as increasing the well depth or diameter, were started.

table:columns.name: ALTERATION_END_DATE
table:columns.description: The date that alteration works, such as increasing the well depth or diameter, were completed.

table:columns.name: DECOMMISSION_START_DATE
table:columns.description: The date that closure works were started in order to take a well permanently out of service.

table:columns.name: DECOMMISSION_END_DATE
table:columns.description: The date that closure works were completed in order to take a well permanently out of service.

table:columns.name: DECOMMISSION_REASON
table:columns.description: Description or rationale for why well was closed permanently, e.g., dry hole, no longer in use, contamination risk.

table:columns.name: OBSERVATION_WELL_NUMBER
table:columns.description: The number assigned to a well within the Provincial Groundwater Observation Well Network, e.g., 552.

table:columns.name: OBSERVATION_WELL_STATUS
table:columns.description: The current status of a well within the Provincial Groundwater Observation Well Network, e.g., Active, Inactive.

table:columns.name: EMS_ID
table:columns.description: A unique identifier from the provincial Environmental Monitoring System (EMS), to be used for connecting to any well monitoring data, e.g., E218071, 1401072.

table:columns.name: AQUIFER_MATERIAL
table:columns.description: A high-level description of the aquifer material type the well is located within, i.e., bedrock, unconsolidated, or unknown.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: A column required by spatial layers that interact with ESRI ArcSDE. It is populated with unique values automatically by SDE.

table:columns.name: SE_ANNO_CAD_DATA
table:columns.description: A binary column used by spatial tools to store annotation, curve features and CAD data when using the SDO_GEOMETRY storage data type.

table:columns.name: geometry_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float not null, ymin: float not null, xmax: float not null, ymax: float not null>
